visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with reddish-brown hair is shown in a tight close-up, wearing a dark grey t-shirt. He looks directly into the camera with a playful smirk while holding a clear glass jar filled with dark brown chocolate spread. He dips his right index finger into the jar, coating it heavily with the sauce, then displays the smeared finger to the lens while nodding mischievously. (2) The scene shifts to a low-angle shot from inside a bathroom doorway, looking out into a brightly lit hallway with white walls and wooden flooring. A small boy wearing a light blue t-shirt and green shorts walks into the frame, holding several sheets of white toilet paper. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a home interior. (3) An adult hand reaches from the left and wipes the brown substance onto the boy's inner forearm as he tries to hand over the paper. The boy stops and stares at his arm with a confused and slightly repulsed expression, while the man's hand remains in the frame pointing at the mark. (4) The boy continues to look at the mark as cartoonish graphics and math formulas float around his head, signifying confusion. The man points and gestures while the boy reacts with various expressions of disgust and skepticism. Finally, the prank is revealed; the man laughs and the boy begins to smile, realizing it is just chocolate. A woman's face is seen laughing in the background doorway.
